mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(country, ''), '未知') AS country, COUNT(*) AS view_count, 0.0 AS percent FROM page_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY country ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(visited_at, #{format}) AS label, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM page_view_log WHERE visited_at >= #{startTime} AND visited_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC
